title: PPLUL + EMOM
author: Bhavin S.
desc: Transform your physique with the PPLUL + EMOM program, an 8-week journey designed for all fitness levels. This 5-day split combines Push, Pull, Legs, Upper, and Lower workouts with Every Minute on the Minute (EMOM) training to maximize muscle growth and sculpt your body. Each session lasts just 50 minutes, making it easy to fit into your busy schedule while ensuring you stay challenged and engaged. Equip yourself with a full gym and get ready to build strength and definition like never before!
